title: Decoding the function of the human glycome using chemical glycoprobes and glycosensor arrays
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01177A, Tutorial Review
Xiao-Peng He
This review emphasizes the development of selective chemical probes for individual glycotransferases and glycosidases, and homogenous sensor arrays for profiling glycan-protein interactions to facilitate disease phenotyping.
